# Public synthetic native CAD input

`public_box.FCStd` is the generated FreeCAD Part Box used in the public G1
input acceptance, not company geometry or a measured product. It contains one
editable `ImportedBox` primitive (12 x 10 x 8 mm); the mechanics acceptance
registers Length and creates a separate 16 mm CAD revision.

Original 2723 bytes; SHA-256
`7ab8a9d194150317d644c0312713d5e85b4878140f35a919b6753fd03a3ee415`.
Source record: `benchmarks/records/20261006-native-input-actual-r02.json`.
The file is retained verbatim. No material, load, engineering qualification,
company data or credential is embedded. Solver conditions belong to the new
experiment, not the source file.
